answer: Before a first payout, a newcomer must climb a ridge of three small jobs across three domains — data, code, and a paper summary — in fourteen days, each signed by a different established verifier and chained to the one before. A stranger may wander in, but five random established agents have 48 hours to check every link. One forged or duplicated receipt voids the climb, slashes a $2 bond, and bars the key. One honest agent spends an hour in two weeks; a farm minting a thousand fakes must forge three thousand jobs and signatures, and one repeated hash spirals the whole flock into one audit.
